description: Run a recipe: a ready-made job of several actions, such as local businesses of one kind in one place with their emails (or only those with weak reviews), a company list with industry, size and register entry, checked work emails for a list of people, a brief on a company and a person before a call, or companies that just raised money, use a named tool or won a public contract, each with the person to reach and a checked work email. The first choice for a person who is not a developer. Without id: the list of recipes and their inputs. With id and inputs: the price of the whole job and a consent sentence; nothing runs. With max_cost_usd as well (once the person agrees): it runs under that total and answers the rows; a longer run answers a run_id, and run_id reads on. Only delivered results are charged. NOT for: one action alone, which is run_capability.

id.description: A recipe id from this tool's own list, such as company-list. Left out, the answer is the list.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this run, 8 to 64 letters, digits or hyphens. It becomes the run_id.

inputs.description: The recipe's inputs, by name, as its entry in the list names them.

max_cost_usd.description: The most the whole run may cost, in USD, such as "0.50". Left out, the answer is the price and nothing runs.

run_id.description: With id: the run_id an earlier call answered, to read that run.

name: run_recipe
title: Run a ready-made recipe
